act_title: The Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, 1957
title: Vesting of land or rights in Central Government
text:
10. Vesting of land or rights in Central Government.—(1) On the publication in the Official

Gazette of the declaration under section 9, the land or the rights in or over the land, as the case may be,
shall vest absolutely in the Central Government [free from all encumbrances].
